_what: Which page answers each sign-in address (GET only), first match wins: `path` is the address, `query` the values its query must hold ("*": any value), a row with `redirect` sends the address on instead of drawing a page; `sections` the files of sections/ drawn between the shell's <main> tags (shell.html is the one shared head, style and script set), `title` and `description` the page's own words. The addresses are the ones the sign-in pages link and post to. `assets` is the folder served under `assets_path`. `headers` go on every page answer: the content security policy (its inline scripts by their sha256, this tool's own script by 'self'), and its referrer and frame rules.

headers.content-security-policy: default-src 'none'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'sha256-XV2pMwAtCff/nRAcbczcBlGODh3xhUUvIEttBnTNlCA=' 'sha256-ogzy1g3cpL1fjXr/EFquCneJwIYbBLAsqgM1GuUlkYA='; connect-src 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'
